request.query: Which technique in the frozen subset connects APT28 through LAMEHUG, and what evidence supports both links?

response.answer: The technique in the frozen subset that connects APT28 through LAMEHUG is Exfiltration Over Asymmetric Encrypted Non-C2 Protocol (T1048.002).

citations.evidence_text:
Record context: APT28 (G0007); LAMEHUG (S9035).

[APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) has used [LAMEHUG](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9035) against targets in Ukraine.(Citation: Nov AI Threat Tracker)(Citation: Cato LAMEHUG JUL 2025)

Record context: APT28 (G0007); Exfiltration Over Asymmetric Encrypted Non-C2 Protocol (T1048.002).

[APT28](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0007) has exfiltrated archives of collected data previously staged on a target's OWA server via HTTPS.(Citation: Cybersecurity Advisory GRU Brute Force Campaign July 2021)
